data.title: opting out of `Send diagnostic reports if Brave crashes or freezes` via `brave://welcome` doesn't work

labels.name: closed/invalid
labels.description: Not an issue with the browser. Possibly opened by mistake or there could be user error

data.body:
<!-- Have you searched for similar issues? Before submitting this issue, please check the open issues and add a note before logging a new issue. 

PLEASE USE THE TEMPLATE BELOW TO PROVIDE INFORMATION ABOUT THE ISSUE. 
INSUFFICIENT INFO WILL GET THE ISSUE CLOSED. IT WILL ONLY BE REOPENED AFTER SUFFICIENT INFO IS PROVIDED-->

## Description 
<!--Provide a brief description of the issue-->

Disabling `Send diagnostic reports if Brave crashes or freezes.` (opt-out) via `brave://welcome` doesn't work. You'll notice that it's still enabled via `brave://settings/privacy` even though the user has checked off the option/opted-out.

## Steps to Reproduce
<!--Please add a series of steps to reproduce the issue-->

   1. launch `1.48.57 Chromium: 108.0.5359.128`
   2. ensure that `brave://welcome` is opened
   3. skip through each screen til you get into the `Help improve Brave` screen
   4. uncheck both `Send diagnostic reports if Brave crashes or freezes.` & `
Share anonymous, private product insights. This helps us learn what Brave features are used most often.`
   5. visit `brave://settings/privacy` and notice that `Send diagnostic reports if Brave crashes or freezes.` is still enabled

## Actual result:
<!--Please add screenshots if needed-->

**`Example`** | **`Example`**
----------------|---------------
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2602313/207778551-47f27fa0-32d0-4505-8fbd-c48eceaed34d.png) | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2602313/207778732-ecee3724-ff0c-4c86-9d95-d202d636cf08.png)

## Expected result:

When the user unchecks/opts-out of  `Send diagnostic reports if Brave crashes or freezes.`, we should ensure that it's disabled and correctly displayed via `brave://settings/privacy`

## Reproduces how often: 
<!--[Easily reproduced/Intermittent issue/No steps to reproduce]-->

100% reproducible using the STR/Cases outlined above.
